drilling.retract_notes: Ceramic filler is hard: use coated (diamond coated) drill bits; aluminium cover sheet with a hard phenolic composite plate on top and a hard phenolic back-up plate; 2 panels per stack for 30 mil and 1 panel for 60 mil, with white paper between two panels; new drill bits for plated holes (500 hits), re-ground bits only for non-plated holes (at most 3 regrinds). Reference table (diameter mm: speed krpm, infeed ipm, retract ipm, max hits): 0.3: 100, 150, 400, 500; 0.5: 75, 120, 400, 500; 0.8: 60, 80, 500, 500; 1.0: 50, 80, 500, 500; 1.5: 25, 50, 600, 500; 3.0: 20, 50, 600, 500. processing.desmear_note: PTFE needs plasma, not chemical, desmear: ultrasonic water wash and bake 110-120 C for 60-90 min, then plasma (O2/H2/N2/CF4 mixtures, 4000 W) in 2 steps for double sided hole activation or 3 steps for multilayer desmear.
processing.bake_note: Thin core and finished boards 110-120 C for 60-90 min; before HAL 150 C for 90-120 min (avoid HAL; tin furnace at most 255 C).

materials.notes: Automotive HDI laminate with its prepreg Autolad1GB. Typical values are for the 1.6 mm (8 x 7628) specimen; Dk and Df are given at 50 % resin content. materials.name: Autolad2GH
materials.notes: High CTI (PLC 0, 600 V or more; the value stored is the limit) automotive laminate with prepreg Autolad2GHB. T288 and T260 are published as greater than 60 min (the value stored is the limit). Typical values are for the 1.6 mm (8 x 7628) specimen; Dk and Df are for the 1.0 mm (9 x 2116) specimen. Thermal stress at 288 C is greater than 100 s. Dielectric breakdown 45+ kV (kV, not per mm) is not stored. For CTI of 600 V the sheet advises 2116 (resin content 54 % or more) or 7628 (45 % or more) outer prepreg.

materials.name: Recyclad1G
materials.notes: Degradable and recyclable halogen-free laminate (CTI class PLC 1). Halogen content Br at most 900 ppm, Cl at most 900 ppm, Br+Cl at most 1500 ppm (EN 14582). T288 and T260 are published as greater than 60 min (the value stored is the limit); thermal stress at 288 C is greater than 10 times. Dk and Df are for the 1.0 mm (8 x 2116) specimen; other values for the 1.6 mm (8 x 7628) specimen.

materials.name: S7439GS
materials.notes: FR-15.1 low-loss laminate, MOT 150 C, storage modulus 24 GPa (DMA). T300 is published as 60 min or more. CTE X/Y is 50-125 C. Resistivities are after moisture resistance. Typical values are for the 0.76 mm (6 x 2116) specimen. Dielectric breakdown 45+ kV (kV, not per mm) is not stored.

materials.name: S7045GHU

materials.name: Autolad3G
materials.notes: FR-15.1 automotive-grade halogen-free laminate, CTI class PLC 3. T300 is published as greater than 60 min (the value stored is the limit). CTE X/Y is 11-13 ppm/C (30-120 C, a range). materials.name: S1190G

materials.notes: Halogen and phosphorus free polyimide film based coverlay for FPC, low adhesive flow, suitable for fast and conventional lamination. Resin flow 0.15 mm; thermal stress passes; dimensional stability +/-0.1 % (standard +/-0.2 %); chemical resistance 90 % (standard 80 %). Typical resistivities (2.0e6 MOhm cm and 1.5e5 MOhm for 0515; 2.5e6 and 1.5e5 for 1025); the standard values are 1e6 MOhm cm and 1e4 MOhm. Peel strength standard 0.7 N/mm (method A) and 0.53 N/mm (method C). Rolls 250 or 500 mm wide, 100 or 200 m long; store at 4-10 C for three months.
